snippet.title: Rain98 - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

Head over to Steam and add Rain98 to your Wishlist.
